# Let me parse the songs from the file content.
import re
content = file_content["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("- "):
        song_line = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get song name and artist
        parts = song_line.rsplit(" by ", 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            song_name, artist = parts
            songs_to_archive.append({"name": song_name.strip(), "artist": artist.strip()})
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive:")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(f"  {s['name']} by {s['artist']}")
